nativeImageCache.scope: QA harness only: a discarded image-selection pass records the exact paths for each frame, restoring Canvas pixels and all renderer properties. Native onload is awaited for those full-resolution images before the retained render; actual drawImage counts exclude selection passes. The production renderer and its normal browser image loading are unchanged.
nativeImageCache.reason: An initial all-resident preload was killed with exit 137 after 136 images and an observed 1165 MiB RSS. No assertion result or capture was claimed for that interrupted attempt.
nativeImageCache.nativeReadiness: Native complete/dimensions can precede pixel readiness; every retained image draw waits for the actual native onload callback.
nativeImageCache.peakMeasurement: Maximum RSS sampled after each native PNG decode and isolated render; not a continuous process peak and not a performance comparison.

decoder.ancillaryMetadataExcludedInMemory: caBX provenance chunks only; the installed Skia decoder rejects these chunks. All source files and all IDAT compressed pixel chunks are retained byte-for-byte.

limits: This receipt describes selected local tests and explicit full-resolution Canvas fixtures, not a complete keyboard browser playthrough.
Global test:all, build and check:built results of previous versions are not inherited by this edition.
All 139 PNGs were decoded; 125 distinct PNG kinds, including all 13 additions, were observed in the tested fixtures. Available mappings and observed types are different counts.
The full novel has not been compared. Exact faces, geometry, materials and globe geography remain project interpretations where sources are insufficient.
The bible retains 552 open and 16 partially implemented work items. Its eight closed items are limited to their declared technical or visual scope.
Full movement, shooting, reloading, interaction and death animation cycles remain incomplete.
The compact flame edit was refused and was not retried; earlier adult and plasma refusals were not retried.
The Canvas image cache and in-memory caBX omission affect the QA harness only; source PNG bytes and production browser loading remain unchanged.
